rows.headline: AECOM takes $337 million pre-tax charge on delayed construction-management project, cuts FY26 EPS guidance to $3.95-$4.15 vs $5.97 consensus
rows.prelim_note: Guidance cut plus a named $337M charge and Q3 revenue -14% YoY to $3.59B directly changes cash flow and earnings expectations (materiality: revenue/margins/cash flow) and moves consensus estimates.

rows.headline: Tenax Therapeutics' Phase 3 LEVEL trial of TNX-103 misses primary endpoint (6-minute walk distance) and key secondary endpoint vs placebo
rows.prelim_note: A failed pivotal trial changes the company's regulatory path and cash-flow-funding risk (materiality: regulatory/operational risk); stock fell 88% same day per market reports.

rows.headline: Inox Wind shares fall 6.4% to a 52-week low after Q1 FY27 net profit drops 34% to Rs 64.1 crore and EBITDA margin narrows to 18.7% from 22.2%
rows.prelim_note: Quantified profit and margin miss with an immediate 6.4% share-price reaction (materiality: revenue/margins/cash flow; shifts analyst expectations).

rows.headline: MarineMax agrees to be taken private by Blackstone-owned Safe Harbor Marinas for $53.00/share cash, a 96% premium, valuing the deal at ~$1.5 billion
rows.prelim_note: A definitive $1.5B take-private deal with a named per-share price directly changes capital structure and ends the company's independent equity story (materiality: capital structure).

rows.headline: Teledyne Technologies agrees to acquire Varex Imaging for $18.90/share cash (~88% premium), a deal valued at approximately $1.1 billion
rows.prelim_note: Named acquirer, named per-share price, and deal value directly change Varex's capital structure and ownership (materiality: capital structure); Varex shares jumped ~50% on the news.

rows.headline: Intel announces a proposed $15 billion common stock offering to fund AI and foundry capex, after raising its 2026 capex forecast to ~$20 billion
rows.prelim_note: A named $15B equity raise (plus a $2.25B underwriter option) directly changes share count and capital structure (materiality: capital structure) and is tied to a quantified capex increase.

rows.headline: Honeywell Aerospace cuts its first post-spin-off 2026 outlook, organic sales growth guidance to 4-5% from 7-9% and adjusted EPS guidance to $7.60-$7.90 (vs ~$8.86 consensus) on casting/forging supply-chain bottlenecks
rows.prelim_note: A named, numeric guidance cut below consensus directly shifts analyst expectations and margin/cash-flow outlook (materiality: revenue/margins; shifts analyst expectations); stock fell ~20-21% on the news.
